statement: You are given an integer array nums and an integer k. Split nums into contiguous pieces, each of length at most k.
After splitting, every element of a piece is replaced by the largest value in that piece.
Return the largest possible sum of the array after this replacement.

examples.explanation: Split it as [1, 15, 7] [9] [2, 5, 10]. The pieces become 15, 15, 15, then 9, then 10, 10, 10, which sum to 84.
